user_query: I'm organizing a gaming tournament and I need to gather information about the top players in DOTA 2 and World of Warcraft. Can you fetch the match history of the top DOTA 2 players and the mythic plus scores of the top World of Warcraft players using the corresponding APIs? Additionally, suggest any sponsorships available in Diablo 4 that could be offered as prizes for the tournament.

TaskList.description: Fetch the match history of top DOTA 2 players.
Fetch the mythic plus scores of top World of Warcraft players.
Research available sponsorships for Diablo 4 that could be offered as prizes.
